title: Protein Structure
description: Fetch experimental RCSB entries, retrieve AlphaFold DB predictions, or parse local PDB/mmCIF coordinates into atom-level protein structure artifacts.

tools.name: structure_fetch_pdb
tools.description: Fetch entry metadata and PDB coordinates from RCSB for a four-character PDB identifier, then return an atom-level viewer artifact.

tools.name: structure_fetch_alphafold
tools.description: Fetch an AlphaFold DB predicted structure for an exact UniProt accession and return a pLDDT-colored viewer artifact.

accession.description: UniProt accession such as P04637, optionally including an isoform suffix.

tools.name: structure_parse_workspace
tools.description: Parse a PDB or mmCIF coordinate file inside the constrained Molemo workspace and return an atom-level viewer artifact.
